description: Admin UI surface for managing mcp_exemptions records. Must include: table listing of exemptions (server_name, reason, valid_until, granted_by), create form, revoke action, and audit trail reference. Ports to localhost:8790, reads via write_service :8772 /query, writes via :8772/write. Must not include any X-API-Key authentication (only internal). Table columns from DB_SCHEMA.md: exemption_id, server_id, reason, valid_until, granted_by, created_at.
